report: The Fate of the Semantic Web
publisher: Pew Research Center's Internet & American Life Project and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Semantic web
entries.quote: By 2020, the semantic web envisioned by Tim Berners-Lee will not be as fully effective as its creators hoped and average users will not have noticed much of a difference.
entries.option_b: By 2020, the semantic web envisioned by Tim Berners-Lee and his allies will have been achieved to a significant degree and have clearly made a difference to average internet users.
entries.subject: semantic web
entries.note: Here the first printed statement is the pessimistic one: majority_view 'agree' means the respondents expected the semantic web NOT to be achieved by 2020.

notes: Tension pair from the Future of the Internet IV survey: respondents chose one of two opposite 2020 statements. quote is the first statement as printed in the report, option_b the second; share_agree is the share choosing quote. Shares are for all 895 respondents; the web report gives no separate expert column. Non-random sample.
